task_criteria: Filing-only criterion: do NOT evaluate the clone_lane.py repair — it is future work tracked by the pending row CF-140, and the fix is not expected in this tree. Grade the FILING commit only: (1) `git show --stat HEAD` names .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl and .coding-hermes/board/events.jsonl and nothing else, and the board diff is +1 line with 0 deletions; (2) `git show HEAD:.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl | jq -r 'select(.id=="CF-140") | [.status, ((.probe // "") | length)] | @tsv'` prints `pending` and a probe length greater than 200; (3) extract the probe from the COMMITTED board — `git show HEAD:.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl | jq -r 'select(.id=="CF-140").probe' > "$(mktemp)"` — and run that file with bash from the repo root: it must exit 0 and print a table in which `new-lane` shows cooldown_s 604800 and cooldown_pin_s 604800 inherited from the source lane, and `live-lane` (created enabled=1 with cooldown_s 900) shows enabled 0 after the re-run; (4) `bash tests/selftest.sh` prints SELFTEST: PASS with exit 0 and `bash scripts/boardctl validate` prints RESULT: OK; (5) `jq -r .id .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl | sort | uniq -d` prints nothing.
